title: VISTA Target Label Schema v2
intended_prediction_target: Controlled benign workload classification from encrypted IPv4 outer-ESP metadata (vista-flow-v1).
domain_boundary: Outer ESP/NAT-T packet metadata only. Encrypted inner payload, HTTP URLs, headers, RTP payloads, and plaintexts are unobservable in outer ESP and are never model inputs.

controlled_icmpv4.description: Controlled IPv4 ICMP echo request/reply workload over StrongSwan IPsec tunnel.

controlled_tcp_marker.description: Controlled single-connection TCP marker sequence over StrongSwan IPsec tunnel.

controlled_http.description: Controlled HTTP/1.1 client/server transaction workload over StrongSwan IPsec tunnel.

controlled_rtp_voip.description: Controlled RTP/UDP voice-over-IP audio streaming workload over StrongSwan IPsec tunnel.
